Name: Madeline's Farmhouse and Farm Building Recolors - UPDATED 10-24-16
Author: madelinealex
Description:
[size=2]Hi, everyone! I first put out a few sets of recolors in March of 2016. With the 1.1 update I'm back and modding again! I have a mill recolor and shed recolors out to match all of my sets at the moment. [img]http://playstarbound.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/HeartIcon.png[/img][/size]

[u]
[/u][size=2][b][u]Note:[/u] [/b]I don't have a save file with all buildings. As a result, I haven't been able to test several recolors. If you have access to a save file with all buildings that you could share with me for testing purposes, I would GREATLY appreciate it! If there are any problems, just let me know and I will fix them for you as soon as I can.

[b][size=3]
[/size][/b][/size][center][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][b][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/madelines-recolors-farmhouses-barns-coops-more-updated-10-23-greenhouse-matches-for-v1-1.110123/][size=4]PLEASE SEE MY THREAD ON THE CHUCKLEFISH FORUMS FOR MORE PICTURES/INFORMATION ABOUT FARM BUILDING SETS![/size]
[/url][size=2][/size][/b][/font][size=2]
I will no longer be posting the pictures here as this format is harder to work with & it's redundant to have the info in two different places. View my thread [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/madelines-recolors-farmhouses-barns-coops-more-updated-10-23-greenhouse-matches-for-v1-1.110123/]here[/url] and an imgur album for all recolors [url=http://imgur.com/a/ILodh]here[/url]. All farm building sets are done with the same colors as their respective farmhouse recolor. The .png for each building is also included in the .rar for the set so that you can preview them before installing.[/size][/center][center][size=5][b]
FARMHOUSE RECOLORS[/b][/size]
[b]
[/b]
I've made a few small changes in addition to recoloring the houses. The 2nd & 3rd house top windows have been made 1 pixel smaller at the top. The 3rd house's door has been changed. I made the window smaller and higher and made the indentions in the door the same size and centered them. I also moved the door handle up a bit and made the doormat look the same as the 2nd house's.

[size=5][b]FARM BUILDING RECOLORS[/b][/size]


Barns, coops, stables, silos, sheds, mills, and wells for your enjoyment! These will be uploaded in full sets.
If you see a new farmhouse recolor above, a matching set of farm building recolors will soon follow (usually).
Stable edits were done using Zhuria's rusty trough fix stable, with her permission. [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/zhurias-miscellaneous-recolours-rusty-trough-fixes-removed-reins.109001/]You can find her lovely version here. [img]http://playstarbound.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/HeartIcon.png[/img][/url]

[size=3][u]VERSIONS AVAILABLE:[/u]
Tan & Navy - Spring Inspired - Summer Inspired - Fall Inspired - Christmas Inspired[/size]


[b][u][/u][/b][/center][left][b]HOW TO INSTALL:[/b]
1. Download the .xnb file of your choice.
2. Find your Stardew Valley Content folder. For most, the directory for the Stardew Valley folder will be something along the lines of C:\Program Files\Steam\steamapps\Stardew Valley\Content.
3. Locate the file you will be replacing by either searching the Content folder or poking around the folders yourself until you find it.
4. BACK UP THE FILE YOU'LL BE REPLACING! A mod could cause an error with your game, or you may want to switch back to the original file in the future. Back it up just in case!
5. Drag a copy of the file to the appropriate folder and write over the original file with the new one.
6. Load up your game and enjoy your recolor! [/left]

[b]DISCLAIMER: PLEASE[/b] do not upload my recolors anywhere else! Unless your edit is different enough to where you can say you were just "inspired" by my palette or whatever you want to call it I would prefer you not edit and reupload my recolors anywhere. The only exception is if I have been offline for a few months and an update breaks the recolors and/or an issue is found with a recolor. In that case if another kind modder fixes it they have my permission to upload their fix. All original artwork credit goes to the ever-so-lovely CA, of course.
